comment: No source is published. What is above comes from the maker's manual, the panel artwork and the module's own port and parameter names. Params 5 (Time Mode) and 7 (Invert) have no widget and no census position, so neither can be clicked and neither gets a line, although the manual documents Time Mode as a panel switch: in this build the only way to reach Sync is to patch a cable into the clock jack, and Invert is reached by long-pressing the phase encoder. Index order is not panel order in the CV row: input 3 is the freq jack and input 2 the amount jack beside it. The 0.01 and 20Hz rate endpoints and the 360 degree phase span are fixed in the module.
